scope: Fresh-context pixel-only visual critic. No prior critic scores or author effort narratives were read. No scene/source mutation.

evidence.view_method: tools.view_image; individual actual PNGs; medical images inspected at original 1067x600 resolution
evidence.normal_lighting_exclusion: HIDDEN_BAG is labelled inspection evidence with temporary 2 W fill; excluded from normal brightness/material-lighting judgment.

categories.name: Layout and route readability
categories.reason: ENTRY, REVERSE, PINCH and all four cutaways show a clear central transfer zone, readable entry and coherent perimeter functions. Recovery, cart and revival bay are spatially distinct. Local floor markings remain subordinate and readable.

categories.name: Grounded stylized art and silhouettes
categories.reason: The authored angular OCRU frame, mechanical carriage, scissor-lift transfer cart, tubular recovery cot, framed cabinet and specific clinical small props avoid a dominant primitive or universal bevel-box read. Mauve/navy/cream/rust color families and controlled secondary construction are comparable to the actual spawn references. Quiet repeated floor tiles and plain storage keep some areas conventional.

categories.name: OCRU hero function and focal clarity
categories.reason: The specialized enclosed red-lit bed is clearly primary in gameplay and elevation views. Cartridge insertion, suit hose, two lift pedestals, guarded restart controls and restrained worker-state display support the reanimation workflow; the ordinary cream/blue cot is distinctly recovery. The empty scene does not demonstrate a live revival state, which is beyond this static visual review.

categories.name: Materials and anti-plastic quality
categories.reason: Matte broad wall paint, enamel frame/cabinet, darker rubber/cushions, cream/blue linen, clinical paper/plastic and controlled metal tubing/instruments have visibly distinct responses. Cabinet glass is dark and translucent rather than toy gloss. No uniform satin-plastic or photographic scratch/noise dominance. Some small modules and dark storage interiors retain restrained, simpler material definition.

categories.name: Dark lighting and atmosphere
categories.reason: Normal cameras show the visible red overhead practical focusing the OCRU bed, a dim warm workbench pool, cool subdued secondary fill, strong falloff and contact shadows. The black ceiling and quieter secondary zones create a bleak clinic without flattening the major silhouettes or losing the route. Upper decon, reserve side and cabinet interiors are very dark; those small hidden details receive no inferred credit. HIDDEN_BAG inspection fill is excluded from this score.

categories.name: Purposeful dressing and neglected workplace story
categories.reason: Worn continuity/productivity poster, return-to-service paperwork, NO PULSE repeats and RELEASE DENIED shift log make corporate exploitation specific. Localized wall paint patches, sparse floor spill/cable marks, handled clinical stock and the closed concealed bag imply an established neglected clinic. Gloves, tape, scissors, pump bottles, sharps/PPE bins and mug are functional clusters. Labels remain restrained; large planes still feel comparatively orderly.

technical_category.name: Technical cleanliness and reproducibility
technical_category.reason: Outside the assigned pixel-only visual scope.

nonblocking_limitations.finding: Upper decon fixture, reserve side/interior and cabinet stock are very dark. Functional outlines remain readable, but those pixels cannot establish subtle finish or aging detail.
nonblocking_limitations.impact: Small-detail visibility only; normal focal hierarchy and route remain legible.

nonblocking_limitations.finding: Regular floor tile rhythm and tidy repeated inventory/storage modules remain comparatively orderly. Localized paint damage, floor marks, worn printed matter and work objects carry most of the neglect.
nonblocking_limitations.impact: Limits the intensity of decay without defeating the established bleak workplace story.

nonblocking_limitations.finding: Rendered pixels cannot establish exact original boundary preservation, millimeter support contact, hidden intersections, source reproducibility, state animation or final two-cycle stability.
nonblocking_limitations.impact: Reserved for independent source-specific technical and stability review; technical category is unscored.

camera_results.label: 19 | ENTRY / PLAYER HEIGHT
camera_results.observation: Clear generous central route. Constructed OCRU frame, rail/bed on left under red practical; recovery cot right with cream hanging textile and distinct folded blue fabric. Opposite restart/cart/cartridge/decon cluster remains readable in dimmer fill. Purposeful cabinetry and sparse localized floor scuffs with clean value groups. Broad walls and shadows preserve austere darkness.

camera_results.label: 20 | REVERSE / PLAYER HEIGHT
camera_results.observation: Main route/exit readable as black doorway between substantial blue/offwhite open leaves. OCRU red bed distinct right and supplies warm task-light pool left, with quieter dark ceiling. Floor/wall localized imperfections; no visible obstruction/unsupported object.

camera_results.label: 21 | RESCUE ROUTE / PLAYER HEIGHT
camera_results.observation: Dim restart/cart shelf/decon remain identifiable and floor route readable across to recovery cot; useful functional grouping, no clutter in circulation. Cabinet remains cooler shadowed blue with glass front.

camera_results.label: 22 | OCRU CARRIAGE / DETAIL
camera_results.observation: Matte stitched mattress pads under controlled red practical, mechanically specific segmented pedestal/rails/clamps; metal tubing vs light enamel and black rubber bag distinct. Closed bag is recessed beneath bed with zipper and tiny yellow note, largely hidden at gameplay angles; not open or ostentatious.

camera_results.label: 23 | CLINICAL WORK / DETAIL
camera_results.observation: Specific gloves, ribbed bottle caps/pump, rolled tape, steel tray/scissors, packet/folded gauze, clipped shift log. NO PULSE repeat/release denied writing makes clinical exploitation legible in close inspection. Matte paper/fabric/plastic vs metal differentiated; visible broad warm task-light falloff.

camera_results.label: 01 | FRONT LEFT / CUTAWAY
camera_results.observation: Full footprint reads as a coherent clinic with contained decon, supply/recovery row and monumental red revival bay. Recovery linen droop and detailed workbench carry lighter value block; wall propaganda/paper is subordinate at this distance. No apparent props blocking the route.

camera_results.label: 02 | FRONT RIGHT / CUTAWAY
camera_results.observation: Corner view separates red OCRU, dark blue wheeled intake gurney, restart/cart/cartridge cluster and recovery/workbench. Sparse floor marks/cable traces and a broad localized upper-wall repair lend use/neglect without blanket grime. Central route remains open.

camera_results.label: 03 | REAR LEFT / CUTAWAY
camera_results.observation: Full-footprint cutaway shows generous central negative space between parallel OCRU and recovery/workbench row; decon enclosure occupies corner, equipment clusters align perimeters. Red bay and warm workbench are distinct directional focal groups. Exposed suspended bars arise from cutaway ceiling removal.

camera_results.label: 04 | REAR RIGHT / CUTAWAY
camera_results.observation: Opposite cutaway confirms room footprint and access route: large central transfer zone, clear exit, OCRU enclosed bay separate from recovery, work surface/cabinet/decon clustered opposite. Quiet charcoal top planes and matte purple/blue institutional walls avoid competing accents.

camera_results.label: 05 | ENTRY WALL
camera_results.observation: Entry elevation shows a robust double door assembly/opening and trim, blue/offwhite panels and darker overhead. Warm supply area remains a supporting focal pool while red OCRU is edge-visible. Functional silhouettes and clear floor cross-route.

camera_results.label: 06 | OCRU WALL
camera_results.observation: OCRU front elevation has a strong angular manufactured bay with enamel lintel/fasteners, dark rubber/blue supports, controls at sides and a specific two-pedestal rail carriage. Single visible overhead red practical concentrates on bed; bag stays low beneath carriage. Nearby dark gurney and localized floor spill/cable marks imply neglected handling.

camera_results.label: 07 | RESTART / DECON WALL
camera_results.observation: Rear functional wall groups restart twin displays and tactile controls, restrained cartridge shelving and framed decon alcove. Quiet wall/utilities above avoid clutter; recovery cabinet stays legible in shadow. The red OCRU remains the dominant foreground landmark.

camera_results.label: 08 | RECOVERY / SUPPLIES WALL
camera_results.observation: Recovery cot is distinct from OCRU: simple tubular frame, cream linen with droop/folds, blue folded blanket; grounded feet and contact shadow. Supply workstation beneath warm wall light has coherent small clinical goods and storage. CONTINUITY/PRODUCTIVITY poster and small return-to-service paper communicate corporate coercion without a text wall.

camera_results.label: 09 | OCRU REANIMATION UNIT
camera_results.observation: Specialized revival apparatus reads through authoritative angular bay, side cartridge/suit hose hardware, two mechanical lift bases and railed clinical carriage. Bed receives focused red practical; darker perimeter encloses it. Closed bag/note stay subordinate in deep low recess. A few procedural labels support interaction rather than substituting for geometry.

camera_results.label: 10 | RESTART CONSOLE
camera_results.observation: Tactile guarded controls, hooded twin industrial displays and different drawer/enclosure modules give a plausible dated medical control workstation. Left display describes machine readiness; employee diagram/awaiting transfer connects the bay to workers. Low screen brightness avoids competing with bed; cabinet lower half is intentionally dark.

camera_results.label: 11 | MEDICAL CARTRIDGE BANK
camera_results.observation: Narrow manufactured rack, repeated labelled cartridges and a visible vacant position give purposeful clinical consumables/storage. Nearby decon threshold/hose and console establish the workflow. Shadow remains dark but shelf/outline/material groups are readable at this framing.

camera_results.label: 12 | RESERVE POWER
camera_results.observation: Open painted blue enclosure with contrasting red door and two specific handled power modules is readable as serviceable reserve hardware. Module rails/latches avoid a bare cube read. Left enclosure and lower interior fall into very deep shadow; small material/age detail is not assessable there.
limitations: Very deep secondary shadows limit small-detail assessment.

camera_results.label: 13 | DECONTAMINATION ALCOVE
camera_results.observation: Framed recessed alcove, hose, wall service box, ribbed drain floor and yellow used-PPE pedal bin clearly separate cleaning/preparation function from beds. Upper fixture is very dark and cannot be fully evaluated; usable hose/bin/control silhouette remains legible. No conspicuous floor obstruction.
limitations: Very deep secondary shadows limit small-detail assessment.

camera_results.label: 14 | RECOVERY BERTH
camera_results.observation: Tubular plain recovery cot with distinct cream mattress/sheet/pillow, broad textile folds, hanging sheet hem and folded blue blanket clearly reads as recovery separate from the OCRU mechanism. Contact shadows and matte textile response ground it. Worn productivity/return poster and service paperwork remain subordinate above.

camera_results.label: 15 | TRANSFER CART
camera_results.observation: Three distinct padded segments, low painted frame, scissor-lift arms/pivot and braked casters make the transfer cart specific and believable. It remains in a dim perimeter strip; charcoal cushions read differently from steel/frame. Sparse loose-looking floor strips nearby suggest neglected work rather than dense decorative clutter.

camera_results.label: 16 | SUPPLY WORKBENCH
camera_results.observation: Constructed workbench has steel frame/storage shelf, contrasting drawer/bin modules and purposeful clinical tabletop cluster. Bottles, gauze/tape, tool tray and log remain legible at this mid-range framing. Warm offwhite table/paper and matte blue/rust storage echo spawn palette; broad wall paint patches show localized aging.

camera_results.label: 17 | HANDWASH STATION
camera_results.observation: Wall-mounted angular soap dispenser, folded-sheet basin, faucet/pipe and sealed-sharps bin form a grounded handwash station with distinguishable enamel/plastic/metal responses. Broad localized wall paint/patch shapes and worn poster edge convey maintenance history; no photographic grunge or noise.

camera_results.label: 18 | MEDICAL SUPPLIES CABINET
camera_results.observation: Painted blue framed cabinet has handles, hinges, fasteners, restrained edge scratches and dark translucent panes with packaged stock behind. Glass reads distinctly from frame and wall without glossy plastic dominance. Interior stock details are very dim and not fully assessable; cabinet function and hardware are clear.
limitations: Very deep secondary shadows limit small-detail assessment.

camera_results.label: 24 | BAG / INSPECTION FILL
camera_results.observation: Labelled temporary inspection fill reveals a closed elongated charcoal bag with zipper track, perimeter seams/carry handles and a tiny yellow sticky note whose writing is not legible. It remains under the carriage in the normal ENTRY/WALL_WEST/HERO_OCRU views. This image proves closed form/detail only; its brighter illumination does not enter normal-lighting judgment.
limitations: Temporary labelled inspection fill; excluded from normal-lighting evaluation.

completion_scope: This is current-batch visual acceptance. Technical acceptance, cold-start/stability and final completion are not certified by this report.
highest_value_optional_polish: Keep any further visibility adjustment confined to the darkest secondary hardware; the red OCRU and warm supplies hierarchy should retain priority.
If further aging is desired, use a few broader localized wear shapes on handled storage rather than adding high-frequency texture noise or extra signs.
